# American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry (AAPD)

> The AAPD is the professional organization for pediatric dentists, offering membership, continuing education, residency training resources, and advocacy for children's oral health.

AAPD serves pediatric dentists and dental professionals with comprehensive resources including an annual conference in Las Vegas, member services, career opportunities, and educational materials. The organization promotes evidence-based pediatric dentistry practices and supports professional development through residency programs, continuing education, and community outreach initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Membership
- Residency Programs
- Continuing Education

## Organization & Membership

- [About AAPD](https://www.aapd.org/about/about-aapd): American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry mission, vision, and organization info
- [Join AAPD](https://www.aapd.org/about/about-aapd/membership-join): Membership application, categories, benefits, and credentials requirements
- [Member Resources](https://www.aapd.org/resources/member): Member portal with dues, governance, awards, and career center access
- [State and District Chapters](https://www.aapd.org/about/state-and-district-chapters): State and district chapter directory with local organization information
- [Get Involved](https://www.aapd.org/about/get-involved): Volunteer opportunities, committees, and charitable giving information

## Education & Professional Development

- [Education Homepage](https://www.aapd.org/education/education-homepage): Continuing education, annual conference in Las Vegas, and CE courses
- [Residency Programs](https://www.aapd.org/resources/member/resident-resources/residency-programs): Residency program information, interview dates, and dental education resources
- [Career Center](https://jobs.aapd.org): Job board and career center for pediatric dentistry positions

## Resources & Support

- [Resources Overview](https://www.aapd.org/resources/resources): Overview of member and parent resources, FAQs, and dental education materials
- [Self Service Portal](https://online.aapd.org/aapdssa/censsacustmast.insert_page): Member self-service portal for profile and account management
- [Practice Checklist Resources](https://www.aapd.org/about/about-aapd/news-room/aapd-practice-checklist-resources): Practice checklists for COVID-19 vaccines, infection control, and office safety

## News & Community

- [Home](https://www.aapd.org): AAPD homepage with conference info, member resources, and community outreach
- [Latest News](https://www.aapd.org/link/40d8c9bbe1d84ae893138470f9496fb1.aspx): News announcements, CEO updates, and pediatric dentistry health information
